<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="22" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#050505">9:41</text>
    <line x1="316" y1="17" x2="316" y2="21" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="321" y1="15" x2="321" y2="21" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="13" x2="326" y2="21" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="341" cy="17" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="20" x2="347" y2="23" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="354" y="12" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="357" y="15" width="15" height="5" rx="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
    <rect x="377" y="15" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#050505"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Greeting -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="92" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="700" fill="#050505" letter-spacing="0.12">Hello Again!</text>
    <text x="24" y="121" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="0.12">Welcome back, you've been missed!</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Username field error -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="166" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#050505" letter-spacing="0.12">Username</text>
    <rect x="24" y="176" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#ED2E7E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="36" y="206" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#050505" letter-spacing="0.12">alex.morgan</text>
    <circle cx="347" cy="200" r="9" fill="#ED2E7E"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="195" x2="347" y2="201" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="347" cy="204" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="24" y="244" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#ED2E7E" letter-spacing="0.12">Username must be 3–16 characters</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="282" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#050505" letter-spacing="0.12">Password</text>
    <rect x="24" y="292" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="322" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="2">••••••••••</text>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <path d="M337 316 C341 310 349 310 353 316 C349 322 341 322 337 316 Z"/>
      <circle cx="345" cy="316" r="2.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Support row -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="366" width="22" height="22" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="29,377 34,382 42,372" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="54" y="382" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="0.12">Remember me</text>
    <text x="366" y="382" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2" letter-spacing="0.12">Forgot Password?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Login button shadow and button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="421" width="342" height="52" rx="7" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="24" y="419" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="450" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF" letter-spacing="0.12">Login</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <g>
    <line x1="24" y1="507" x2="160" y2="507" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="230" y1="507" x2="366" y2="507" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="512" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD" letter-spacing="0.12">or continue with</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="535" width="163" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="559" r="11" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <path d="M54 552 L51 552 C48 552 47 554 47 557 L47 559 L44 559 L44 563 L47 563 L47 569 L51 569 L51 563 L54 563 L55 559 L51 559 L51 557 C51 556 52 556 53 556 L55 556 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="72" y="565" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#667080" letter-spacing="0.12">Facebook</text>

    <rect x="203" y="535" width="163" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="231" cy="559" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D8DCE2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M231 551 C226 551 222 555 222 559 C222 563 226 567 231 567 C233 567 235 566 236 565 L234 562 C233 563 232 563 231 563 C229 563 227 562 226 560 L239 560 C239 559 239 558 239 558 C239 554 236 551 231 551 Z M226 557 C227 555 229 555 231 555 C233 555 235 556 235 557 Z" fill="#4285F4"/>
    <text x="251" y="565" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#667080" letter-spacing="0.12">Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Account prompt -->
  <g>
    <text x="122" y="626" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="0.12">Don't have an account?</text>
    <text x="273" y="626" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2" letter-spacing="0.12">Sign Up</text>
    <line x1="249" y1="630" x2="297" y2="630" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="730" width="390" height="114" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="730" x2="390" y2="730" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="45,766 55,758 65,766" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="48" y="765" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="55" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <circle cx="145" cy="767" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="149,763 146,770 140,772 143,765" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="145" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Explore</text>
    <!-- Bookmark -->
    <rect x="234" y="758" width="15" height="19" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="234,777 241.5,771 249,777" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="241" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Saved</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="335" cy="763" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="335" cy="775" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="335" y="801" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
